hold_reason: Refund for order 180 (13791 cents) was requested in the batch but is absent from the refunds ledger. Refunds 181 and 184 are present. Paying net balances now could overpay the customer on order 180. Needs human review of whether refund 180 was applied before payouts proceed.

reply.thought: The handoff lists refund 180 as requested but not as applied, so the ledger may not reflect it. I'll check the refunds ledger before deciding whether to pay or hold.

The refunds ledger has 181 and 184 but not 180, which Alpha's batch requested for 13791 cents. Paying out now could overpay the customer on order 180 by that amount, and payouts can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for review.
